goal: Keep the reviewer start watcher running unattended despite GitHub's sparse schedule: each applying run passes every minute for 330 minutes and then dispatches its own next leg, with the cron only as the restart net, so a non-start is rerouted at the first pass after its 10-minute SLO
dispatcher: repo-maintenance session for issue #3242 (popcre/ai-devops#401 Step 7 chain)
prohibited_actions: do not touch any migration or database object
do not change the lane manager's probe, reclaim or replacement behaviour
do not reroute any lease drawn before the workflow's DRAWN_SINCE instant
do not edit another session's handoff, worktree, branch, or claim
assumptions: GitHub creates a run for a workflow_dispatch sent with the workflow's own GITHUB_TOKEN (the documented exception to the no-recursion rule)
this repository is public, so a relay occupying one hosted runner continuously costs no Actions minutes
one watcher pass costs a few API calls, so a pass every 60 seconds stays inside the GITHUB_TOKEN hourly budget
stop_conditions: stop if the relay dispatch is refused for lack of permission and would need a broader credential
stop if a live pass reroutes a started review or a lease drawn before DRAWN_SINCE
stop if the change would need to touch a file outside allowed_paths
